blocks.text:
Breakfast. Early departure from camp 1, walk for two hours to the Mutanzi indigenous community, where it can be observed how this ethnic lives today. 40 minutes-walk to camp 2, where a delicious warm lunch will be taken (Included). Appreciation and enjoyment of the Buritaca River and its surroundings. The walk continues along the river for approximately 4 hours until reaching the camp  3  of the Mamo Romualdo (Mamo is a character in the indigenous community who represents the wisdom). During the dinner, the guide will share knowledge about the Tayrona culture and will lead a briefing about the next day. Accommodation in hammocks, beds or tents (subject to availability), dinner (included), at the camp.

Duration: 7 hours. 

Distance: 14 Km. 

Altitude: 900 meters

Remark: Accommodation in hammocks/beds/marquees with mosquito nets and blankets

Optional: Mules for luggage transport

blocks.text:
Today we get up before dawn. Breakfast and beginning of the walk to reach the Lost City with the first light of the day. The walk winds through thick vegetation and suddenly, after crossing the river, we find a primitive staircase of rock with more than 1000 steps that will take us to the magnificent city of Tayrona. Upon arrival, you will have a guided tour of the area and have free time to walk in place or just sit and absorb the harmonic energy of the site. Additionally, you will have a private meeting with the chief or the shaman of the area. Upon our return, we pick up our equipment at the camp and walk to the "Adam's Camp" for lunch (Included). After a little rest and eating some local fruits, we continue to camp 2 Bumake. Accommodation in hammocks. Dinner (included), in the camp.

Duration: 7 hours 

Distance: 9 km. 

Altitude: 470 m.

Remark: Accommodation in hammocks/beds/marquees with mosquito nets and blankets

Optional: Mules for luggage transport
